title: I see someone who died
content: It probably sounds crazy. Some may not understand, but sometimes I stop taking my clonidine so I can see him. I take clonidine for my mental health and it works wonders, but the psychiatrist had asked me if I have nightmares. I told him not really; although I do, I just didn’t realize they’re nightmares since I enjoy having them, but I did mention my Mall World and reoccurring dreams. He told me that the medicine will fix my reoccurring dreams “problem”, but I told him it’s not a problem. I really didn’t think the impact it would have, but I visit my “other life” less, and to access it guaranteed, I stop the med for a couple days (really bad, don’t recommend). I am able to lucid dream a lot (what a gift). Before he died, I told him to haunt me or visit me in my sleep. He was my first love I loved for 22 years. I hadn’t seen him in my world until over a year later after he passed. He’s been visiting more frequently, and the last one felt incredibly real, and I was able to control it. It’s already difficult to access my beach, but him and I were able to go there easily and sit under a palm tree like we used to do when we were younger. In my dream, I was telling myself to take this opportunity to spend time with him and don’t wander off in the dream. Him and I talked for hours watching the sunset which was one of our favorite pastimes. He was in his gray hoodie from high school with a plastic water bottle. I cried a lot and told him how much I missed him and how things aren’t the same with him gone. He told me he had to go, and I remember being grateful I got to speak to him and say my goodbyes to him. I told him to visit more often, and he said he would. We hugged and he turned around and disappeared into the sunset. It felt really spiritual. It felt REAL. I play the dream in my mind like a movie, and I feel absolutely stupid that I stop taking my meds on the weekends just so I can live my “other life.” I get it is not a healthy way to deal with grief, but the dream gave me a sense of peace. Does anyone else have this experience with people that passed away in their small World?
